snippet.title: Release Date Trailer | Colossal Kickoff
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3670200/Colossal_Kickoff/

COLOSSAL KICKOFF is launching in Early Access on Steam on MAY 16! Check out this brand new trailer showing off the awesome monsters and exciting plays you'll find in the game!

Colossal Kickoff is a Spine-Crushing, Blood-Pumping, Monster-Mashing 1-on-3 Arcade Soccer game coming soon to PC!
Check out our official website: https://www.colossalkickoff.com
